ui_bugs.issue: My Payroll tab is hidden when coordinator has no sessions assigned. The tabs are inside a conditional block (sessions.length > 0) which prevents access to payroll information.

action_items: Fix CoordinatorDashboard.jsx: Move My Payroll tab outside the sessions.length > 0 conditional block so coordinators can access their payroll even without assigned sessions
critical_code_review_comments: CoordinatorDashboard.jsx line 1067-1110: The Tabs component with My Payroll tab is inside a conditional block that only renders when sessions.length > 0. This prevents coordinators without sessions from accessing their payroll information. The My Payroll tab should be accessible regardless of session assignment.
